candidatos_directos.justificacion: The story requires sending notifications, which is exactly the function of the Correspondence service domain’s Initiate operation and its Outbound schema. The service role explicitly states automated generation of correspondence, matching the story’s verb and object.
candidatos_directos.rol_bian: This service domain handles the automated generation of (batches of) pre-formatted correspondence. It also handles the tracking of expected responses to sent out mail requests and handles the matching of the response and the onward routing of these and all unsolicited inbound correspondence.

operaciones_bian.justificacion: The InitiateOutbound operation creates an outbound correspondence item, which includes fields for addressee address and communication method, enabling notifications to both old and new phone/email addresses.
operaciones_bian.bq_seed: envía una notificación al celular o correo anterior

evidence_refs: Service Role: automated generation of pre-formatted correspondence

candidatos_descartados.justificacion: La historia requiere enviar notificaciones tras actualizar datos de contacto; el dominio Party Reference Data Directory solo mantiene y permite actualizar datos de referencia de la parte, sin operación de notificación. Por tanto la historia consume este dominio como fuente de datos, no lo administra.
candidatos_descartados.rol_bian: The party reference data directory service domain maintains a potentially wide range of party reference data that might be used in any interaction between the bank and the party including relationship development, sales/marketing, servicing and product delivery. This can include general reference and contact details, party associations, demographic details and some servicing preferences. Different information may be maintained for different party types such as individuals, corporates, partners

candidatos_descartados.justificacion: La historia se enfoca en el envío de notificaciones por actualización de datos personales, mientras que el Service Domain Fraud Evaluation maneja la ejecución estructurada de pruebas de detección de fraude en transacciones. No existe alineación entre las capacidades del dominio y el objetivo de la historia.
candidatos_descartados.rol_bian: This service domain handles the structured execution of fraud detection tests/routines that are used to identify possible fraud by detecting out of pattern behaviors. The tests may run in-line with production or may access transaction logs as appropriate. Detected anomalies are passed for further analysis and resolution.
assumptions: El dominio de fraude no es responsable de la mensajería o notificaciones transaccionales de actualización de datos.
gaps: Falta un Service Domain dedicado a la gestión de notificaciones o correspondencia en el alcance proporcionado.
